nodes.label: Decomposer Agent
nodes.rationale: Chain-of-thought chosen over least-to-most because iterative least-to-most is inefficient and needs stopping criteria; dynamically judges difficulty, emits 1-5 sub-questions with sub-SQLs in a single pass, up to 2 few-shot demonstrations.

nodes.label: MAC-SQL Framework
nodes.rationale: LLM-based Text-to-SQL degrades on huge databases and complex multi-step questions, and existing methods neglect external tools and model collaboration; MAC-SQL uses a core Decomposer plus auxiliary Selector and Refiner agents activated as needed, extensible to new tools.

nodes.label: Refiner Agent
nodes.rationale: Executes SQL via external SQLite tool, diagnoses syntax errors, schema hallucinations, and empty results, then repairs; up to 3 correction rounds for efficiency. Limitation: cannot fix SQL that runs and returns non-empty but semantically wrong results.

nodes.label: Selector Agent
nodes.rationale: Too many irrelevant schema items raise the chance of irrelevant items in SQL and full schemas inflate API cost/context length; activated only when schema tokens > 0.8*max context (25k for GPT-4-32k); keeps top-6 columns per table, keep_all for <=10 columns, drop_all for irrelevant tables, JSON output with one-shot example.

nodes.label: CLINSQL Benchmark (633 expert-annotated tasks)
